articles.title: NASA’s Universe of Learning Unveils Fresh Facilitator Guides Inspired by Community Feedback
articles.summary: The goal of NASA’s Universe of Learning (UoL) is to connect the public to the data, discoveries, and experts that span NASA’s Astrophysics missions. To make this possible, the NASA’s UoL team creates engaging STEM experiences that let people explore data and discoveries from NASA’s Astrophysics missions and learn from the experts behind them.
